**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Feature Category**
- [ ] Generation Modes (txt2img, img2img, etc.)
- [ ] AI Providers (HuggingFace, OpenAI, etc.)
- [ ] UI/UX Improvements
- [ ] API Enhancements
- [ ] Performance Optimization
- [ ] Security/Privacy
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

**User Impact**
Who would benefit from this feature?
- [ ] Free tier users (20 generations/day)
- [ ] Pro users
- [ ] Enterprise users
- [ ] All users

**Implementation Ideas**
If you have ideas on how this could be implemented, please share:

**Additional context**
Add any other context, screenshots, or mockups about the feature request here.

**Priority**
- [ ] High - Critical for my workflow
- [ ] Medium - Would improve my experience
- [ ] Low - Nice to have

**Willing to contribute**
- [ ] I can help implement this feature
- [ ] I can help test this feature
- [ ] I can provide feedback on design
- [ ] No, but I appreciate the work!
